Rung 2, security to the pilot (ROE-6.1), is allowed at LOW or above with operator approval, and it is the least force likely to work. The jammer is allowed in principle at MEDIUM with operator plus control room approval. It is not needed yet, and the tower has not confirmed that no crewed aircraft is within 3 km (ROE-5.2, N-12). The laser, interceptor and gun are blocked: threat level is too low, there is no PVID, and the line beyond the target is in Z-APPR, a never-backstop zone.
